remarks: Welcome to resort-style living in the highly desirable Trilogy at Glen Ivy, a premier 55+ active adult community nestled in the scenic foothills of South Corona! This inviting residence offers a wonderful combination of comfort, thoughtful upgrades, and everyday convenience. Step inside to discover beautiful maple wood flooring, a spacious family room with a cozy fireplace and built-in entertainment center, and a dedicated dining area perfect for entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen features upgraded appliances and a convenient pantry, while ceiling fans and window blinds throughout add comfort and functionality.
